subject: Partner-led discovery recap & next steps - CloudBridge marketplace integration
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Mar 2026 18:12:00 +0000
Subject: Partner discovery recap & proposed next steps (CloudBridge)

Hi Sophie -

Thanks again for coordinating the intro earlier today - great to learn more about CloudBridge's marketplace onboarding flow and the types of customers you're accelerating. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can align on a technical deep dive / demo:

Recap:
- Goals: make Redwood available via CloudBridge Marketplace listing + streamlined procurement for mutual enterprise customers.
- Primary blockers: marketplace packaging requirements (billing metadata, SKU mapping), and a short security questionnaire we need to share for marketplace listing.
- Timeline: Sophie suggested a 2-3 week pilot with one joint customer after STAGE-1 approvals.

Proposed next steps:
1) Technical deep dive / demo (45 min) - we can cover API integration, SKU mapping, and onboarding checklist. Recommend including one of our SEs (Dylan) for the integration questions.
2) Share onboarding checklist and marketplace integration diagram (attached).
3) Align on a HubSpot deal record and carrier for a joint pilot (I can create the deal if you confirm the customer).

Availability for the demo (PDT):
- Tue 17 Mar, 09:00-09:45
- Tue 17 Mar, 13:00-13:45
- Wed 18 Mar, 11:00-11:45

If those don't work for you, send a few windows and we'll match. I'll loop in Aditya (partnerships) and Dylan (SE) on the follow-up.

Thanks - looking forward to continuing this.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192
